text: Testing is a crucial part of creating good software. Two main types of tests are used to check different things. Unit tests focus on small, individual pieces of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly on their own. Integration tests, on the other hand, check that different parts of the system work well together when combined. Many developers use a practice called test-driven development, where they write a failing test first, then write the code to make it pass. This approach helps build confidence in the software because you know immediately if a change breaks something. Regular testing reduces bugs and makes it safer to update and improve your project over time.
